notes.fiscal_year: Fiscal year ends on the Sunday closest to 31 October: FY26 ended 1.11.2026 (Q4 not yet reported, due ~10.12.2026). Base year = FY26; forecast years FY27..FY32; the 5-year point = end FY31 (~31.10.2031), 4.98 years from today.
notes.growth: FY27 base +58.3% = AI semis ~115,000 (management on the Q3 call: 'secured the supply to again double AI revenue to approximately $115 billion' in FY27, from ~58,000 in FY26; secondary sources, transcript not read) + non-AI semis 17,600 (Q4 guide 26.1B semis - 21.7B AI = 4.4B a quarter, flat) + software 35,000 (FY26 22,726 + Q4 guide 8,700 = 31,426; +11%, ARR +15%) = 167,600. Consensus FY27 revenue 174,227 (AV, 49 analysts, range 114.7-200.1B). FY28 base +37.8% = AI 175,000 (management target ~230,000 haircut 24% for Google multisourcing to MediaTek (Macquarie: Broadcom share of TPU 95% in 2026 -> 80% 2027 -> 65% 2028, attributed), deployment/financing risk of the Anthropic 10 GW and OpenAI >5 GW plans) + non-AI 18,000 + software 38,000 = 231,000. Then +12/+8/+6/+5%. Bull = AI beat record (Q3 AI 16.7B vs 16.0B target; FY26 AI ~58B vs prior 56B) and the full 230B FY28 target: +69% (AI 125B), +60.6% (AI 230B), +20/+12/+9/+7. Bear = hyperscaler capex digestion + Google moving TPU share to MediaTek + customers using rival design partners (Marvell, Alchip) or in-house + VMware churn: FY27 +29.4% (AI flat at the Q4 run rate ~87B, software +2%), FY28 -7%, FY29 -16% (AI ~60B), then +2/+4/+4.
notes.margin: Operating margin AFTER SBC; acquired-intangible amortization excluded (not an economic cost), restructuring ~0.3% ignored. Q3 FY26: non-GAAP OI 20,095 / 29,591 = 67.9% - SBC 2,019 (6.8%) = 61.1%. Q4 guide: non-GAAP OM ~66% (CFO) - SBC ~2.0B/34.8B (5.7%) = ~60.3%. Non-GAAP GM falls with XPU/rack mix: 78.4% Q3 FY25 -> 77.1% Q2 FY26 -> 75.0% Q3 FY26 -> ~73% Q4 guide; Hock Tan on the Q3 call: 'we expect to be able to sustain operating margin even as mix of products dilutes the gross margin'. FY27 base 60% = the guided ~66% non-GAAP OM less SBC ~5.4% of revenue (~9B), fading to 57% by FY31 (pricing pressure as Google multisources TPU to MediaTek and labs use rival design partners). Bull 61->62% (management's FY28 plan: '>$30 EPS'). Bear 54->46% (rack GM + price pressure + deleverage when revenue falls; FY25 after-SBC margin was ~54%).
notes.conv: FCF after SBC / NOPAT. 9M FY26: FCF 31,937 - SBC 6,287 = 25,650 + after-tax interest ~1,840 = 27,490 vs NOPAT (47,849 - 6,287) x 0.84 = 34,910 -> 0.79 (receivables +6.5B, inventory +2.3B in 9M; cash taxes 2.2B vs non-GAAP provision 7.4B). Base 0.80/0.85/0.95/1.0; bear releases working capital as revenue falls (0.85/1.0/1.05/1.0).
